title: Taiwan, Japan eye joint push against China's gray zone expansion in Indo
description: Taiwan is considering deeper strategic coordination with Japan on a range of security issues linked to China's growing regional assertiveness, according to statements made by Taiwan's National Security Bureau (NSB) Director-General Tsai Ming-yen. The development follows Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi's unveiling of a revised Indo-Pacific Strategy that places strong emphasis on maritime security, supply chain resilience, and technological cooperation, as reported by The Taipei Times.

title: US revises UN resolution on Iran but China, Russia still expected to veto
description: Washington has altered its United Nations resolution demanding Iran cease attacks in the Strait of Hormuz. However, diplomats believe China and Russia will still veto the proposal. This comes ahead of President Trump's visit to China. The revised draft removed a clause allowing for sanctions or military action. Despite this, strong language against Iran remains.
